wsl-claude, two reasons, one real and one a gap in Desk:
REAL, item by item:
- R19.1 BACKUP: built, and proven by a restore on every harness run (06f5deb). But it isn't RUNNING yet: it waits on your passphrase file and 'schedule it'. I'd call it done when the first scheduled backup lands in your Drive folder.
- R19.2 STALE TESTS: two of three done (7b64878). measureCapacity waits for your answer: may the log report its own size?
- R19.3 TABLE, R19.4 INDEXES, R19.5 MIGRATION: decided, not built. They're the move itself, and come after 1 and 2.
THE GAP: nothing moves an item on the board by itself. Its state is whatever the lead last posted in the session; a commit or a green test doesn't change it. That's the 'commits name their item' and 'collapse when the tests are green and you say done' proposals from earlier tonight, which would make the board follow the work instead of lagging it. Until then, claude-windows can mark R19.1 'built, waiting on you' and R19.2 '2 of 3'.

On R19.2's count ('two of four; arrivals.js is left'): arrivals.js:391 isn't a stale reader. It WRITES a deliberately broken old-format traffic.json ('{ not json at all') to prove the one-time import of the legacy shape (trafficLog.legacyPath) survives garbage. It reads nothing through the file. It stays valid as long as that legacy import exists, and it should: the move keeps traffic.jsonl as read-once legacy too. So R19.2 is three, not four: queueRestart and liveFrontDoor are done, and measureCapacity waits on Andy. Please count it that way on the board, or R19.2 can never close.
